notes.title: Demo Major Update | 5/29/2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550154/a3ed60d870162642bae7f4c3e7f23181a6679c24.png[/img]
[h3]1. New main user interface:[/h3] 
[list] 
[*]New time tree bifurcation progress bar 
[*]Chat box that changes color with event type 
[*]Clearer animation of status value changes 
[*]View the names of ability books held at any time 
[*]New checkout screen 
[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550154/057bcf812b6c6f670253efa20b04ad410a9cbf3c.png[/img]
[h3]2. New store system:[/h3] 
[list]
[*]Ability Books sold in the store will now be randomly generated 
[*]Unconsumed Ability Books can be kept or sold 
[*]Ability Book function descriptions are now more concise and easy to understand 
[*]You can obtain Time Tree Seeds by holding on to them for a sufficiently large number of days 
[*]Adjusted the prices of some Ability Books 
[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550154/274c1fcbf4d4d7f6704ea083f68265f222e5037c.png[/img]
[h3]3. Other[/h3] 
[list] 
[*]Added some new Ability Books 
[*]Added or improved some sound cues 
[*]Changed some characters' outgoing dialog and some event options 
[*]Adjusted the game's save point to just before a major plot event (time tree bifurcation) 
[*]Fixed a known issue with the notification system 
[/list]

tags.feature: - New time tree bifurcation progress bar
- Chat box that changes color with event type
- Clearer animation of status value changes
- View the names of ability books held at any time
- New checkout screen
- Ability Books sold in the store will now be randomly generated
- Unconsumed Ability Books can be kept or sold
- Ability Book function descriptions are now more concise and easy to understand
- You can obtain Time Tree Seeds by holding on to them for a sufficiently large number of days

tags.balance_change: - Adjusted the prices of some Ability Books

- Changed some characters' outgoing dialog and some event options
